summary.goal: Implement pipeline Steps 2-5: the deterministic extraction layer that transforms SessionData into PreExtract. Four distinct functions, each with clear inputs and outputs. extractEntities uses compromise.js for NLP entity extraction with a custom tech lexicon. extractFacts pulls structural facts from events. matchTopics compares entities against existing memory/ files. filterTranscript extracts only decision-adjacent exchanges. The output PreExtract is the stage boundary — everything downstream may use LLM. This stage does ~80% of the value work at $0 cost and <100ms.

acceptance_criteria.description: extractEntities(sessionData) uses compromise.js to extract: topic keywords, technology names (OAuth, PKCE, SQLite...), file paths, function names, proper nouns
Entity extraction includes custom lexicon for common tech terms that compromise.js doesn't know natively
extractEntities processes both messages[].content and events[].description
extractFacts(sessionData) produces Fact[] from: tool calls made, files modified, errors encountered, status transitions, decision points with timestamps
extractFacts treats trajectory decisions and retrospective as high-signal: extracts as pre-structured facts with type 'decision' or 'retrospective'
matchTopics(entities, memoryDir) reads existing memory/ filenames and YAML frontmatter tags
matchTopics returns TopicMatch[] with confidence scores (0-1) and isNew flag for proposed new topics
matchTopics uses entity text overlap with filename stems and frontmatter tags for scoring
filterTranscript(sessionData, entities) extracts only exchanges around key decision points, not full history
For trajectory sources, chapter boundaries and decision events guide filterTranscript window selection
For relay sources, agent-to-agent decisions and broadcasts are prioritized over routine messages
Full extraction pipeline (all 4 functions) runs in <100ms for a typical 1-hour session
Zero API calls — entire stage is pure computation
Output PreExtract contains: sessionId, source, entities[], facts[], topicMatches[], filteredTranscript[], existingTopics[]
buildPreExtract(sessionData, memoryDir) composes all 4 functions and returns PreExtract
Topic assignment algorithm: confidence threshold (default 0.3) — entities with no match above threshold are grouped by co-occurrence into new topic proposals
extractFacts sets Fact.isPreStructured = true for trail decisions (Decision.source = 'trail'), marking them for direct nugget conversion downstream
filterTranscript window: +/-3 messages around decision events for relay/transcript sources; expand to chapter boundary for trajectory sources

observations: The 4 functions have clear dependency chain: entities → matchTopics (needs entities), filterTranscript (needs entities), facts (independent)
So extractEntities and extractFacts can run in parallel, then matchTopics and filterTranscript can use entity results
compromise.js processes ~1MB/sec — a 1-hour session transcript is typically 50-200KB, so <200ms even without parallelism
Custom tech lexicon needed because compromise.js is general English NLP — TypeScript, OAuth, PKCE, SQLite, etc. are not in its default lexicon
matchTopics is a simple scoring function: count entity overlaps with existing topic filenames and frontmatter tags
filterTranscript is the most heuristic-heavy function — needs empirical tuning for window size around decisions
Spec says ~200 lines for extract.ts — this is achievable because each function is focused
concerns: compromise.js custom lexicon maintenance: tech terms evolve, new frameworks appear
filterTranscript window size: too small loses context (agent won't understand nugget), too large wastes LLM tokens
matchTopics with empty memory/ directory: all entities become 'new topic' proposals — need sensible grouping heuristic

steps.title: Implement extractEntities with tech lexicon
steps.description: Build extractEntities(sessionData) using compromise.js for NLP entity extraction. Create a custom tech lexicon that registers common technology terms (OAuth, PKCE, SQLite, TypeScript, React, Vitest, etc.) as proper nouns so compromise.js recognizes them. Extract: topic keywords, technology names, file paths (regex pattern for path-like strings), function names (camelCase/PascalCase patterns), proper nouns. Process both messages[].content and events[].description. Return Entity[] with text, type, and frequency count.

acceptance_criteria.description: Uses compromise.js with .extend() to register custom tech lexicon
Tech lexicon includes common terms: OAuth, PKCE, SQLite, TypeScript, React, Vitest, Express, Zod, etc.
Extracts topic keywords, technology names, file paths, function names, proper nouns
Processes both messages[].content and events[].description
Returns Entity[] with text, type (keyword|tech|filepath|function|noun), and frequency
Deduplicates entities by normalized text, summing frequency counts

steps.specification: Location: src/extract/entities.ts. Export extractEntities(sessionData: SessionData): Entity[]. Use compromise.plugin() to register tech lexicon as { words: { 'OAuth': 'ProperNoun', ... } }. File paths detected via regex /[\/\w-]+\.\w{1,10}/. Function names via /\b[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*\b/ (camelCase) and /\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]+\b/ (PascalCase, filtered against lexicon). Lexicon stored as separate const for easy extension.

steps.title: Implement extractFacts with isPreStructured flag
steps.description: Build extractFacts(sessionData) that produces Fact[] from structural session data. Extracts facts from: tool calls made (type: 'tool_call'), files modified (type: 'file_modified'), errors encountered (type: 'error'), status transitions (type: 'status_change'), decision points with timestamps (type: 'decision'). For trail decisions (Decision.source = 'trail'), sets Fact.isPreStructured = true, marking them for direct nugget conversion without LLM processing. Retrospective summaries extracted as type 'retrospective' facts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Extracts tool call facts from events with type tool_call
Extracts file modification facts from events with file paths
Extracts error facts from events with error indicators
Extracts decision facts from Decision[] with reasoning preserved
Trail decisions (Decision.source = 'trail') produce facts with Fact.isPreStructured = true
Each fact includes timestamp, type, description, and optional metadata

steps.specification: Location: src/extract/facts.ts. Export extractFacts(sessionData: SessionData): Fact[]. Fact type: { type: string, description: string, timestamp: string, isPreStructured?: boolean, metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }. Check decision.source === 'trail' to set isPreStructured. Process sessionData.events, sessionData.decisions, sessionData.retrospective in order.

steps.title: Implement matchTopics with confidence threshold
steps.description: Build matchTopics(entities, memoryDir) that reads existing memory/ filenames and their YAML frontmatter tags, then scores each entity against existing topics. Confidence scoring based on entity text overlap with filename stems and frontmatter tags. Entities above confidence threshold (default 0.3) are matched to existing topics. Entities below threshold are grouped by co-occurrence (entities that appear in the same messages/events) into new topic proposals with isNew = true. Returns TopicMatch[] with confidence scores.

acceptance_criteria.description: Reads existing memory/ filenames and parses YAML frontmatter tags using gray-matter
Scores entities against topic filename stems and frontmatter tags
Confidence threshold default 0.3: entities above threshold matched to existing topics
Entities below threshold grouped by co-occurrence into new topic proposals with isNew = true
Returns TopicMatch[] with topicSlug, confidence (0-1), isNew flag, and matched entities
Empty memory/ directory: all entities become new topic proposals grouped by co-occurrence

steps.specification: Location: src/extract/topics.ts. Export matchTopics(entities: Entity[], memoryDir: string, opts?: { threshold?: number }): TopicMatch[]. Read all .md files in memoryDir (excluding index.md), parse frontmatter with gray-matter. Score: exact match on filename stem = 1.0, partial match (substring or tag overlap) = 0.3-0.8. Co-occurrence grouping: entities appearing in the same 3+ messages are proposed as a single topic. Proposed topic slug generated from highest-frequency entity in the group.

steps.title: Implement filterTranscript with source-aware windowing
steps.description: Build filterTranscript(sessionData, entities) that extracts only decision-adjacent exchanges from the session data. For trajectory sources: expand window to chapter boundary around decision events (include entire chapter containing the decision). For relay/transcript sources: use +/-3 messages around decision events. Decision events identified from sessionData.decisions timestamps. For relay sources, prioritize agent-to-agent decisions and broadcasts over routine messages. Returns FilteredExcerpt[] with excerpted messages and the decision context.

acceptance_criteria.description: Extracts exchanges around decision events, not full session history
Trajectory sources: window expands to chapter boundary (entire chapter containing the decision)
Relay/transcript sources: window is +/-3 messages around decision event timestamp
Relay sources prioritize agent-to-agent decisions and broadcasts over routine messages
Returns FilteredExcerpt[] with messages, decision context, and source metadata
Overlapping windows are merged to avoid duplicate messages in output

steps.specification: Location: src/extract/transcript.ts. Export filterTranscript(sessionData: SessionData, entities: Entity[]): FilteredExcerpt[]. Detect source type from sessionData metadata or events (chapter_start events indicate trajectory). For +/-3 window: binary search messages by timestamp to find nearest, take slice. For chapter expansion: find chapter_start events, use as window boundaries. Merge overlapping FilteredExcerpts by checking message overlap.

steps.title: Implement buildPreExtract compositor
steps.description: Build buildPreExtract(sessionData, memoryDir) that composes all 4 extraction functions and returns a PreExtract object. Runs extractEntities and extractFacts in parallel (they are independent). Then runs matchTopics and filterTranscript (both depend on entities). Assembles the PreExtract with: sessionId, source, entities[], facts[], topicMatches[], filteredTranscript[], existingTopics[]. The PreExtract is the stage boundary — everything downstream may use LLM.

acceptance_criteria.description: Composes all 4 extraction functions into single buildPreExtract call
Runs extractEntities and extractFacts in parallel (Promise.all)
Runs matchTopics and filterTranscript after entities are available
Output PreExtract contains: sessionId, source, entities[], facts[], topicMatches[], filteredTranscript[], existingTopics[]
Full pipeline runs in <100ms for a typical 1-hour session
Zero API calls — entire stage is pure computation

steps.specification: Location: src/extract/index.ts. Export buildPreExtract(sessionData: SessionData, memoryDir: string): Promise<PreExtract>. Use Promise.all([extractEntities(sessionData), extractFacts(sessionData)]) for parallel phase. Then sequential: matchTopics(entities, memoryDir), filterTranscript(sessionData, entities). existingTopics populated from matchTopics results where isNew === false.

steps.title: Write extraction layer tests
steps.description: Comprehensive test suite for all extraction functions. Tests entity extraction with tech lexicon recognition, fact extraction with isPreStructured flag on trail decisions, topic matching with confidence threshold and co-occurrence grouping, transcript filtering with source-aware windowing (+/-3 and chapter boundaries), and buildPreExtract composition. Include performance test verifying <100ms for typical session size.

acceptance_criteria.description: Entity extraction tests: tech terms recognized via lexicon, file paths extracted, function names extracted, deduplication works
Fact extraction tests: tool calls, file modifications, errors, decisions extracted; trail decisions have isPreStructured=true
Topic matching tests: confidence scoring correct, threshold filtering works, co-occurrence grouping for below-threshold entities, empty memory/ dir handled
Transcript filtering tests: +/-3 window for relay/transcript, chapter boundary expansion for trajectory, overlapping windows merged
buildPreExtract composition test: all fields populated, parallel execution verified
Performance test: extraction completes in <100ms for 200KB session data

steps.specification: Location: src/extract/__tests__/extract.test.ts. Use Vitest. Create realistic SessionData fixtures. For topic matching tests, create tmp memory/ directories with sample .md files and frontmatter. Use performance.now() for timing assertions.
